ACCOUNT CLOSURE POLICY

1. Voluntary Closure
Customers may request account closure at any branch or via the customer portal. Accounts closed within 14 days of opening ("cooling-off period") incur no closure
charge. Accounts closed between 14 days and 12 months of opening incur a closure
charge of INR 500. No charge applies after 12 months. 2.

- Original passbook / unused chequebook leaves (if applicable)
- Signed closure request form
- Valid government-issued ID for verification

3. Outstanding Dues
All outstanding dues, including any linked loan EMIs, credit card balances, or
negative balances, must be cleared before closure is processed.

loans linked as collateral cannot be closed until the loan is fully repaid or
transferred. 4. Processing Time
Standard closure requests are processed within 7 working days. Closure requests
involving a linked Fixed Deposit or active loan may take up to 15 working days due to
additional verification. 5.

Accounts with no customer-initiated transactions for 24 consecutive months are
classified as dormant. Dormant accounts with a zero balance for 12 additional months
may be closed by the bank after written notice to the customer's last known address
and registered email.

subject to approval. Customers may request deferral of up to 2 EMIs per loan tenure. Interest continues to accrue during the deferral period, and the tenure is extended

FRAUD AND UNAUTHORISED TRANSACTION POLICY

1. Reporting Window
Customers must report any unauthorised or suspicious transaction within 3 working days
of receiving the transaction notification to be eligible for zero-liability protection. Reports made between 4 and 7 working days may still be eligible for limited liability
protection, subject to investigation.

Upon report, the transaction is provisionally reversed (a "shadow credit") while
investigation proceeds. Investigations typically conclude within 10 working days. If
fraud is confirmed, the shadow credit becomes permanent.

PERSONAL LOAN POLICY — FICTIONAL BANK (v3.2)

1. Eligibility
Applicants must be salaried or self-employed individuals aged 21 to 60 years, with a
minimum monthly net income of INR 25,000 for salaried applicants or annual turnover of
INR 12,00,000 for self-employed applicants.

or standard approval; applicants with a score between 650 and 699 may be considered
under the Secondary Review process with additional documentation. 2. Loan Amount and Tenure
Personal loans range from INR 50,000 to INR 25,00,000. Repayment tenure ranges from 12
to 60 months. The maximum loan amount is capped at 20 times the applicants average
monthly net income. 3.

Interest rates range from 10.5% to 18% per annum, determined by credit score, income
stability, and existing debt-to-income ratio. Rates are fixed for the full tenure and
do not change after disbursement. 4.

Loans may be foreclosed after 6 EMIs have been paid. A foreclosure charge of 3% of the
outstanding principal applies.

EMI is calculated using the standard reducing-balance formula:
EMI = P x r x (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1)
where P = principal, r = monthly interest rate (annual rate / 12 / 100), n = tenure in
